method: Per-second RMS in dBFS over 16-bit PCM at 44.1 kHz; speech_until = last whole second above -50 dBFS; the tail is every second after it.
reference_source: the six reference 1024-frame whole replies of before/after benchmark 01 (same corpus and method as 02)
finding: All six reference 1024-frame replies show the same signature as native long-05: speech stops early (reference 3-6 s, native about 11 s), then near-silence at about -95 dBFS until the 1024-frame cap. Reaching the cap without an end of speech is not native-specific.
inference: [INFERENCE] Both engines sample a trajectory that collapses to silence tokens without emitting end of speech; the cause in the model or the sampling is not established. Native returns this clipped audio as HTTP 200 with X-Finish-Reason: length; the reference returns it as a plain 200.
not_a_fix: The text is still not fully spoken by either engine for these items.
